'''Needia Solum''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Information broker/Legends|informant]] for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateCommoner.png|250px|thumb|Every possible depictions of Needia Solum]]
Needia Solum was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="AED" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>

Because Needia Solum spawned under the generic "commoner" template, her appearance was randomized under one of a 120 possible depictions. [[Species/Legends|Species]] Solum could appear as included [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]], [[Bothan/Legends|Bothans]], [[Bith/Legends|Bith]], [[Human/Legends|Humans]], [[Rodian/Legends|Rodians]], [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshans]], [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'leks]], and [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] of either gender, and [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronians]], [[Ishi Tib/Legends|Ishi Tib]], [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]], and [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustans]] of the male gender. The [[W:c:swg:Quest|quest]] dialogue identified Solum as female, however the [[canon]]ical species cannot be definitively determined in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity.<ref name="AED" />
